responsibility: Defines the tree-structured intermediate representation of type layouts used before automaton construction, including sequencing, alternation, definition/reference/byte leaves, pruning of safety-invariant definition nodes, inhabitedness checks, and rustc-backed construction of layout trees from compiler type layouts. It must gracefully handle layout construction failures caused by unnormalized types, normalization failures, inference variables, or already-reported type errors, returning a supported error state instead of forcing layout of an invalid type during transmutability diagnostics.
